==Usage==
Options '''in bold''':
*{{C|Since Wookieepedia cannot handle more than one #if parser function for this specific template, there is only one optional parameter for this template:}}
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Themes|saga=1}}
:The above should be used on articles on '''themes/leitmotifs that originated from the [[Star Wars saga|nine saga films]]'''.
*For '''themes/leitmotifs that originated from non-saga films''', excluding those that directly tie in to television series, {{C|i.e. [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'']]}} use {{Tl|Themes/Film}}
*For '''themes/leitmotifs that originated from television series''', use {{Tl|Themes/TV}}
*For '''themes/leitmotifs that originated from [[Star Wars video games|video games]]''', use {{Tl|Themes/Game}}
*For '''themes/leitmotifs that originated from any ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge]]'' media''', use {{Tl|Galaxy's Edge music}}
*For '''songs''', {{C|songs are ''not'' themes/leitmotifs}} see the instructions [[Template:Songs|here]].
*If an article on a theme/leitmotif fulfills '''none of the above''' criteria, simply use the following, but avoid doing so wherever possible due to the length of the full template:
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Themes}}
